critical.msg: FastAPI-to-Flask framework migration with no migration plan or backward compatibility layer. This removes async ORM (asyncpg), Pydantic request/response validation, and FastAPI dependency injection. Entire API contract likely broken.
Removed alembic/ directory and migration tooling — production database schema management broken. Cannot apply future schema changes.

warnings: docs/EXTERNAL_ACCESS.md line 124: CORS_ORIGINS=* — wide-open CORS inappropriate for CRM system with customer PII
docs/EXTERNAL_ACCESS.md: Contains DATABASE_URL with real-looking credentials; if this is production, credentials should not be in version-controlled docs
suggestions: Keep FastAPI as an optional route layer or maintain dual-framework compatibility
Restore Alembic migrations or document alternative DB migration strategy
Lock down CORS_ORIGINS to specific domains in production
Remove or redact DATABASE_URL credentials from version-controlled docs
Add integration tests to verify API contract after framework changes
llm_parsed.summary: This diff introduces a breaking architectural migration: FastAPI → Flask removes async support, Pydantic validation, and dependency injection without any transition strategy. 2 critical issues: (1) entire API layer rewritten with no validation guarantees, (2) database migration tooling removed. No security vulnerabilities (injection, XSS) found, but CORS misconfiguration noted. Performance acceptable with gunicorn threading model. Recommend reverting or providing proper migration path with backward-compatible API surface.
